title.en: Dexter’s deliberately limited angle
title.zh: 刻意收窄的德克斯特角度

paragraphs.en: Dexter Morgan is the title character of the original crime series, which depicts serious violence. This edition does not turn those actions into virtues or traits assigned to you. It independently selects only careful observation of harmless, invented props. The match does not suggest emotional detachment, hidden urges, a diagnosis or a capacity for crime. Read it as a small editorial comparison, not a complete character portrait.
paragraphs.zh: 德克斯特·摩根是原犯罪剧同名主角，剧集呈现严重暴力。本版不把这些行为变成美德或赋给你的特质，只独立选观察无害虚构道具这个小角度。匹配不暗示情感疏离、隐藏冲动、诊断或犯罪能力；把它当小范围编辑比较，不当完整人物画像。

title.en: An envelope of invented props

paragraphs.en: A club opens an envelope containing a drawing, a label and a toy token for a completely fictional puzzle. You first describe how the small details are arranged, without deciding that the arrangement must reveal a particular answer. The observations give the group something concrete to compare. There is no real evidence, victim or suspect here, and noticing a pattern does not establish that your interpretation is correct.
paragraphs.zh: 社团拆一封完全虚构的谜题信封，里面有画、标签和玩具标记。你先描述小细节怎样摆，不预先决定必然指向哪个答案。观察给小组具体比较对象。这里没有真实证据、受害者或嫌疑人；看见规律也不确立解释正确。

title.en: Observation beside five other contributions

paragraphs.en: Debra asks a plain question, Angel keeps people included and Masuka explores the playful mechanism. Doakes questions an inconsistency while LaGuerta clarifies the scope and roles. Dexter’s selected angle describes the detail before interpreting it. These contributions can coexist in the same paper game without ranking intelligence, competence or morality, and a tied reading does not reveal a hidden personality or a darker self.
paragraphs.zh: 黛布拉问平实问题，安吉尔让人有参与感，马苏卡探索趣味机关；多克斯质疑不一致，拉圭尔塔约范围分工。德克斯特角度在解释前描述细节。可共存于纸上游戏，不评智力、能力或道德，并列也不揭示隐藏人格或黑暗自我。

title.en: A pattern is a starting point

paragraphs.en: Similar details can have several explanations, especially in a handmade game with imperfect props. Ask what would support or contradict the first reading, and allow the organiser to correct an accidental inconsistency. A high count here does not establish obsessive attention, suspiciousness or forensic talent. It also gives no reason to scrutinise real people, collect private information or treat ordinary behaviour as evidence of wrongdoing.
paragraphs.zh: 相似细节可有几种解释，手作道具也可能不完美。问什么支持、什么反对初读，并让组织者纠正无意的不一致。高计数不确立强迫关注、多疑或法医天分，也不构成审视真人、收集隐私或把普通行为当作过错证据的理由。

title.en: Try two columns for one fictional prop
title.zh: 给一个虚构道具列两栏

paragraphs.en: For a paper puzzle, make two short columns: what you can directly describe and what you think it might mean. Invite a willing partner to add another possible interpretation. Afterwards, notice whether separating the columns helped the game discussion. This is feedback on a harmless hobby method, not a test of investigative skill, emotional capacity or the ability to read another person.
paragraphs.zh: 纸上谜题里列两小栏：直接能描述什么、觉得可能意味着什么。请愿意的伙伴添另一个解释，再看分栏是否帮助讨论。这是无害爱好方法的反馈，不测调查技能、情感能力或看透他人的本领。

title.en: Debra’s limited angle

paragraphs.en: Debra Morgan appears in the original cast, and the official character biography identifies her as a police officer and Dexter’s sister. This edition selects a separate, ordinary angle of asking a direct question when the next step is unclear. It does not infer anger, toughness, trauma, gender expectations or the quality of your relationships. A plain question in a hobby group is not a test of professional interviewing ability.
paragraphs.zh: 原剧名单包括黛布拉·摩根，官方人物简介确认她是警员、德克斯特的妹妹。本版另选普通角度：下一步不清楚时直接提问。不推断愤怒、强硬、创伤、性别期待或关系质量；兴趣小组的平实问题也不测专业访谈能力。

title.en: The step everyone keeps circling

paragraphs.en: A fictional clue game has stalled because people are discussing possible answers before agreeing what the next instruction asks. You put the missing question into one sentence. That can make uncertainty discussable without blaming anyone for not understanding. You may still need to listen to a longer explanation; asking directly does not guarantee that every answer will be short or immediately satisfying.
paragraphs.zh: 虚构线索游戏卡住了，大家没约清下一条说明要做什么，就开始聊答案。你用一句话问缺的部分，让不确定可讨论，不责怪谁没理解。仍可能要听较长解释；直接问不保证答案都短或立刻满意。

title.en: A plain voice beside five other contributions
title.zh: 平实声音与另外五种贡献

paragraphs.en: Dexter observes details, Angel supports an inclusive exchange and Masuka tests a playful example. Doakes challenges an unsupported assumption, while LaGuerta gives the discussion a workable structure. Debra’s selected angle states the question plainly. Each contribution may help at a different moment, without ranking honesty, confidence or effectiveness. A close result can be useful without becoming a hidden second character.
paragraphs.zh: 德克斯特观察细节，安吉尔让交流有参与感，马苏卡试趣味例子；多克斯质疑无支持假设，拉圭尔塔给讨论可行结构。黛布拉角度平实说出问题。不同阶段都可有用，不评诚实、自信或效果，近分也不变成隐藏第二人物。

title.en: Directness still leaves room for an answer

paragraphs.en: A question is easier to answer when it describes the actual gap rather than implying that someone has failed. Ask what is needed, then allow a response or a request for time. You can also choose a quieter format. A high count does not prove bluntness, emotional volatility or assertiveness, and a lower count does not mean you are dishonest or unable to speak for yourself.
paragraphs.zh: 描述实际空缺的问题，比暗示谁失败的问题更容易回答。问需要什么，再留回应或多想一会的空间，也可用安静形式。高计数不证明生硬、情绪不稳或果断，低计数不表示不诚实或不能为自己表达。

title.en: Try one concrete question

paragraphs.en: In one optional club task, name the exact information you need before continuing. Ask for that information in a plain sentence and listen before adding another question. Afterwards, compare what became clearer with what still needs discussion. The exercise concerns a local exchange, not your courage, communication competence or a duty to confront people more often.
paragraphs.zh: 一次可选社团任务，指出继续前确实需要的信息，用平实句子问，再先听后补问。之后比较哪些清楚了、哪些仍需讨论。这关乎具体交流，不测勇气或沟通能力，也不要求更常与人对峙。

title.en: Angel’s limited angle

paragraphs.en: Angel Batista is part of the original-series ensemble named in the official distribution cast list. This edition independently selects a friendly, inclusive contribution to an optional group activity. It is not an assessment of empathy, optimism, loyalty or moral goodness, and it does not summarise all his fictional decisions. You can recognise this angle without becoming responsible for every person’s feelings or for keeping a group together.
paragraphs.zh: 官方发行名单中的安吉尔·巴蒂斯塔是原剧群像一员。本版独立选可选集体活动里友好、让人参与的贡献，不评共情、乐观、忠诚或道德善良，也不概括全部虚构决定。可以认出这个角度，不必负责每个人感受或维持整个群体。

title.en: The newcomer at the puzzle table

paragraphs.en: Someone arrives after a paper-mystery group has opened the first clue. You give a short recap and make room for them to ask a question or simply watch. The welcome is useful when it fits what they want, rather than requiring an enthusiastic response. You can help the person join without restarting everything or taking over their choices about how much to participate.
paragraphs.zh: 纸上谜案小组拆过第一条线索后，有人刚到。你简短回顾，留提问或只看的空间。欢迎好用在于合对方意愿，不要求热情回应。可以帮加入，不必全部重来，也不接管对方参与多少的决定。

title.en: Inclusion beside five other contributions
title.zh: 参与感与另外五种贡献

paragraphs.en: Dexter describes details, Debra asks what needs answering and Masuka demonstrates the playful part. Doakes identifies a contradiction and LaGuerta clarifies roles and time. Angel’s selected angle helps people remain part of the conversation. These can support the same session without ranking kindness, popularity or social skill. Several close guides do not establish a hidden identity or a permanent support role.
paragraphs.zh: 德克斯特描述细节，黛布拉问要回答什么，马苏卡演示趣味部分；多克斯指出矛盾，拉圭尔塔约分工时间。安吉尔角度让人仍在交谈中。可支持同一活动，不评善良、人气或社交技能，近分也不确立隐藏身份或永久辅助角色。

title.en: An invitation can be declined

paragraphs.en: Someone may prefer to observe, speak later or leave the activity. Make those options easy rather than treating participation as proof that your welcome worked. You can also set a limit on your own availability. A high count cannot establish selflessness, conflict avoidance or emotional warmth, and a lower count does not prove indifference or a lack of care.
paragraphs.zh: 有人想观察、稍后说或离开。让这些选择容易，不把参与当成欢迎成功的证明。自己也可限制能投入多少。高计数不确立无私、回避冲突或温暖，低计数不证明冷漠或不关心。

title.en: Try a short recap with an open choice
title.zh: 试一段留选择的短回顾

paragraphs.en: For one willing newcomer, explain what the group has done and offer a clear choice to join, watch or skip. Ask later which information was useful. Notice whether the invitation was usable rather than how much attention you gave. This is feedback about one arrangement, not a test of empathy, friendship quality or suitability for a caring profession.
paragraphs.zh: 对愿意听的新人，说明小组已做什么，明确可加入、可看、可跳过。之后问哪些信息有用，留意邀请是否好用，不只看给了多少关注。这是具体安排反馈，不测共情、友情质量或照顾类职业适配。

This edition independently selects playful curiosity about a harmless mechanism or example, rather than claiming an official personality profile. It does not measure intelligence, humour, laboratory ability or professional judgement. Playfulness here means an optional part of a hobby game that others can enjoy or decline; it does not excuse unwanted jokes or any harmful fictional conduct.

title.en: A toy lock with an extra feature
title.zh: 玩具锁多出来的小功能

paragraphs.en: A paper puzzle contains a toy lock with an unexpected feature that is not necessary to solve the story. You enjoy trying it and seeing what makes it amusing. The extra can be worthwhile as play without becoming a claim about the answer. If the group prefers to move on, you can keep the experiment brief or return to it on your own later.
paragraphs.zh: 纸上谜题的玩具锁多了意外功能，却不影响解故事。你喜欢试一试，看看有趣在哪里。额外部分可作为游戏有价值，不变成答案主张。大家想继续时，可短试一下，或以后自己回来玩。

title.en: Play beside five other contributions

paragraphs.en: Dexter notices the detail and Debra asks a plain question. Angel keeps people included, Doakes checks the unsupported claim and LaGuerta defines a workable scope. Masuka’s selected angle makes room for an entertaining experiment. Each contribution may help a different part of the session, without ranking creativity, seriousness or skill. A tie preserves the full readings rather than selecting a better kind of person.

title.en: Check whether the play is welcome

paragraphs.en: An entertaining extra can distract from a task someone else wants to finish. Ask whether people would like to try it and keep the choice genuinely optional. You can enjoy curiosity without demanding an audience. A high count cannot establish impulsivity, social confidence or technical expertise, and a lower count does not mean you lack a sense of humour or interest in how things work.
paragraphs.zh: 有趣额外部分可能打断别人想完成的任务。问愿不愿试，让可选真的可选；可享受好奇，不要求观众。高计数不确立冲动、社交自信或技术专长，低计数不表示没幽默或不关心东西怎样运作。

title.en: Try an optional two-minute demonstration
title.zh: 试一个可选的两分钟演示

paragraphs.en: Choose one harmless toy or paper mechanism and offer a brief demonstration to a willing partner. Separate what is fun to explore from what the puzzle actually requires. Afterwards, ask what was enjoyable or distracting. The exercise is feedback on one optional example, not a test of technical aptitude, comic talent or permission to joke at somebody else’s expense.
paragraphs.zh: 选无害玩具或纸机关，给愿意伙伴一个短示范。分开“探索起来好玩”和“谜题实际需要”，之后问什么愉快、什么分心。这只反馈一个可选例子，不测技术天分、喜剧才能，也不许可拿别人取乐。

Challenging a claim in a paper game is separate from judging a real person’s intentions, honesty or risk, and the result offers no authority to investigate other people.

title.en: Two cards that cannot both be right
title.zh: 不能同时成立的两张卡

paragraphs.en: A completely fictional mystery includes two cards whose written details contradict each other. You name the mismatch and ask which part needs checking before the group calls the solution complete. It may be an intentional puzzle, an editing error or a misunderstanding. Asking for support can help the game without assuming that the organiser is deceptive or that the first challenge must win.
paragraphs.zh: 完全虚构的谜案有两张文字矛盾的卡。你说出对不上之处，问解完前需核哪部分。可能是刻意谜题、编辑失误，也可能误解。要支持能帮助游戏，不必假设组织者欺骗，也不必让第一次质疑赢。

title.en: A challenge beside five other contributions

paragraphs.en: Dexter describes the details, Debra states the missing question and Angel keeps the exchange inclusive. Masuka tests a playful example while LaGuerta organises the next step. Doakes’s selected angle checks what supports the claim. These contributions can coexist without ranking honesty, courage or judgement, and several full results do not establish a hidden or more suspicious personality.
paragraphs.zh: 德克斯特描述细节，黛布拉说缺的问题，安吉尔让交流好参与；马苏卡试趣味例子，拉圭尔塔组织下一步。多克斯角度检查主张的支持。可共存，不评诚实、勇气或判断，并列全文也不确立隐藏或更疑虑的人格。

title.en: A challenge should be open to an answer

paragraphs.en: Ask what could resolve the contradiction and allow the answer to change your view. The point is not to keep raising objections after the group has a workable explanation. You can agree on a temporary game rule when the original wording is imperfect. A high count cannot establish distrust, moral rigidity or superior reasoning, and a lower count does not prove gullibility.
paragraphs.zh: 问什么能解决矛盾，也容许回答改变自己看法。目的不是有了可行解释后仍不断反对。原文不完美时，可共同约临时游戏规则。高计数不确立不信任、道德僵化或推理更强，低计数不证明易受骗。

title.en: Try one specific, answerable challenge
title.zh: 试一个具体、能回答的质疑

paragraphs.en: In a fictional puzzle, identify one claim and the exact clue that appears not to fit. Ask what would explain the difference, then compare the proposed answer with the cards. Keep the discussion about the invented material. This is feedback on a game explanation, not an assessment of critical-thinking ability or a reason to suspect real people of wrongdoing.

title.en: More preparation ideas than time

paragraphs.en: A mock-mystery club has an afternoon plan, limited supplies and more suggested extras than it can comfortably finish. You help agree which parts are necessary, who genuinely wants each role and when preparation is complete. The plan remains a shared arrangement, not an instruction others must accept. A smaller scope can preserve enjoyment without turning the hobby into a professional project.
paragraphs.zh: 模拟谜案社团有下午安排、有限用品，额外点子却多到做不完。你帮约必需部分、谁真想接哪个角色、准备何时算完成。计划仍是共同安排，不是别人必须接的命令。范围缩小可保留乐趣，不把爱好变职业项目。

title.en: Coordination beside five other contributions

paragraphs.en: Dexter observes details, Debra asks plainly what is needed and Angel attends to participation. Masuka explores an amusing mechanism while Doakes checks a contradiction. LaGuerta’s selected angle makes the shared commitment workable. These contributions can support one session without ranking maturity, influence or competence, and a close or tied reading does not assign a permanent leader or support role.
paragraphs.zh: 德克斯特看细节，黛布拉平实问需要什么，安吉尔留意参与；马苏卡探索有趣机关，多克斯核矛盾。拉圭尔塔角度让共同承诺可做。可支持同一活动，不评成熟、影响或能力，近分并列也不永久分派领导、辅助角色。

title.en: An agreement needs real choices

paragraphs.en: A clear plan helps only when people can say what they can offer, decline a role or ask to revise the scope. Do not treat your preferred order as everyone’s consent. If circumstances change, return to the agreement openly. A high count cannot establish controlling behaviour, managerial talent or confidence, and a lower count does not mean you are disorganised or unable to take responsibility.
paragraphs.zh: 清楚计划好用，要让人能说提供什么、拒绝角色或改范围。别把自己喜欢的顺序当所有人同意；情况变了公开回到约定。高计数不确立控制行为、管理天分或自信，低计数不表示散乱或不能负责。

title.en: Try a short shared definition of done
title.zh: 试一个简短共同完成条件

paragraphs.en: For one optional club task, write the outcome, a realistic stopping point and the roles people have chosen. Invite corrections before beginning, and leave an easy way to reduce the scope. Afterwards, compare the agreement with the actual experience. This is feedback on a planning arrangement, not an assessment of professional ability, authority or whether you should manage other people.
